title: Audit Trail
definition: A record of events that have taken place within the CADMIES knowledge system, including operations performed, timestamps, and associated data.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of an audit trail as a logbook that records every event in a computer system. In the CADMIES system, it keeps track of what actions are performed, when they're performed, and what they do.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: An audit trail is a sequence of records that document system activities. In the context of the CADMIES system, it provides a history of operations, enabling users to trace the evolution of the knowledge base and identify any anomalies or inconsistencies.
difficulty_levels.expert: The audit trail in the CADMIES system serves multiple purposes. It facilitates accountability and transparency by providing a traceable record of system operations. It also supports system debugging and maintenance, and it can be used to derive statistical insights about the system's usage patterns.

extra_fields.insight: The audit trail in the CADMIES system provides a record of all system activities, enabling users to trace the evolution of the knowledge base and identify any anomalies or inconsistencies.
